title: Springfield Ballet's The Nutcracker
description: Springfield Ballet's The Nutcracker is scheduled for December 17, 2026, Time TBD at The Landers Theatre, 311 E. Walnut Street, Springfield. Springfield Ballet, Inc. is the organizer. The price is $40.00 adult; $35.00 senior/student/military; $29.00 children 12 and under; $25.00 groups 12+.
